steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Erosion is the removal and transport of weathered material by rivers, wind, ice and gravity | Key Fact: River erosion processes: hydraulic action (force of water), abrasion (sediment scraping bedrock), attrition (particles rounding), solution (dissolving) | Key Fact: Transport methods: traction (rolling large particles), saltation (bouncing), suspension (fine particles carried in water), solution (dissolved load) | Key Fact: Deposition occurs when the transporting agent loses energy: river slows (inside of meander, floodplain), glacier melts, wind drops

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from erosion, transport &amp; deposition, and one past-paper question.
